calls.title: Demo Call with Julio Perdiguer Ordóñez from Docplanner
calls.summary: The team focused on unifying five different feature flag and experimentation tools into a single, scalable platform that supports both client and server-side toggles and advanced experimentation features by Q4. Key discussions included the need for advanced experimentation capabilities to accelerate decision-making, thereby shortening the significance time of experiments from 4-6 weeks to 2-3 weeks. Pricing transparency was emphasized, with cloud enterprise pricing set at a baseline of $50,000 plus $1,000 per user annually, and a self-hosted option available for $45,000. Data residency compliance was addressed with the upcoming launch of an EU data center. Technical insights covered the flexible architecture with SDKs deployed across various environments, and the decision-making process involved gathering feedback from stakeholders to ensure that the platform meets business needs effectively.
calls.keywords: feature flags, experimentation platform, GrowthBook, pricing model, data residency, SDK architecture
